lines.name: CARD
lines.text:
2:13 AM. The deck is done.
You are not.

lines.name: STRANGER
lines.text: You're doing the thing where you stare at the pie like it owes you money.

lines.name: STRANGER
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: Long life, by the look of it. What do you do?

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: Spreadsheets. For a guy who takes credit for them.

lines.name: STRANGER
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: And what did you want to do?

directions.text: rain on the window, the neon buzz, the pie case hum
